Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: This section directs staff on the safe handling of pet travel requests, check-in, and incident reporting at Aurelia Skyways.

Staff must verify travel details before acceptance, keep carriers secure, and remind passengers that animal welfare comes before convenience. If a traveler is anxious, stay calm, use plain language, and give clear steps without hurry. <<FACT F091>> The passenger coordinator should then confirm that the booking record matches the travel documents and carrier details. Do not accept incomplete information or make promises that fall outside the approved process.

For check-in, staff must inspect the animal carrier, confirm the pet appears fit to travel, and ensure the passenger understands movement limits and cabin expectations. <<FACT F098>> Any concern about behavior, ventilation, or restraint must be raised at once so the matter can be reviewed before the animal is accepted. If a traveler presents a pet such as Minnie, treat the case with the same standard as any other request and avoid special handling unless it is authorized.

If an incident occurs, staff must record the facts promptly, note what was seen, and preserve any related documents or messages. <<FACT F090>> The report must be clear, factual, and free of guesses. Supervisors listen carefully when a passenger is worried, and staff should pass concerns on without delay. Contact the senior coordinator or the shift desk if further guidance is needed.
